newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed in light volume.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed in light volume.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed with the most-active May contract unchanged after USDA's crop report data came in about as expected, traders said.
"It was a very quiet session as most USDA numbers that were presented had already been talked about," a trader said.
USDA on Tuesday pegged rice ending stocks at 24.6 million cwt, slightly above February's estimate for 24.3 million. Exports were raised to 76 million cwt from 75 million in February's report.
Supply increases came from a jump in projected imports to 9.0 million cwt from 7.8 million.

Traders said they expected activity to remain subdued as the market waited to see the expiration of the March contract. Floor sources noted open interest as of Monday was 570 contracts, a hefty amount so close to expiry. The contract expires March 19.
On the day, LIT was a buyer of the May and a seller of the March, traders said.
Rice closed two cents per cwt higher to two cents lower with May unchanged at $11.76.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 700 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 671 lots.
